fusions.name: Tangling Snare
fusions.desc: Snags every enemy within 3 tiles, dealing 10 damage, stripping 15% of their armour and slowing them by 30% for 6 seconds, then stuns each for 1 second.

fusions.name: Matted Rip
fusions.desc: A tearing bite that deals 4 damage, makes the target [Bleeding] for 1 damage a second for 4 seconds and slows it by 25% for 2 seconds.

fusions.name: Woven Mat
fusions.desc: Raises a barrier that absorbs up to 20 damage for 12 seconds, and raises your armour by 6% while it holds.

fusions.name: Knotted Whip
fusions.desc: Each time you strike, a snare lashes the nearest enemy within 4 tiles for 4 damage and slows it by 25% for 2 seconds. Once every 6 seconds.
